mentioned.quote: Risks of enabling large-scale sophisticated cyber- attacks, including on critical systems

threshold.quote: The model provides substantial capability uplift to small organizations by removing existing bottlenecks to scaling cyber operations, including by automating end-to-end cyber operations against reasonably hardened targets
threshold.note: Cyber offense Tier 2; Tier 3 also defined. Tiers are 'measurable thresholds for decision-making' (p.9).

response.quote: If residual risks associated with the model exceed acceptable risk levels, the model is not deployed unless additional mitigation measures are implemented that sufficiently minimize risk.
response.note: E3 generic gate; no named safeguards (p.13 'appropriate safety mitigations', p.17 security mitigations concern own systems). Applies to all systemic risks in scope.

acc_decider.note: p.13 SAG and external experts only inform the justification (advise); p.20 Safety and Security Committee and the OpenAI Ireland board provide 'oversight' of framework updates and EU compliance; p.21 Legal oversees updates. acc_external.note: p.19 'We may solicit and obtain input from external experts' and independent third-party evaluators is hedged; p.8 third-party evaluations are only an example of validating evidence ('such as'); p.17 'internal and external assessments' validate OpenAI's own security controls (present-tense practice).

acc_unmet.quote: we will draft and implement a remediation plan, and update the FGF as appropriate.
